name: Google Gemini
description: Read-only Gemini access: the account's catalogue of available Gemini models. Sending a generateContent request is a billable POST against the account's usage, so it is modelled as write:true and HITL-gated rather than fired here. Auth uses the x-goog-api-key header (preferred over the ?key= query param, which would otherwise land the secret in a logged URL).

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the Gemini models available to this API key, with their display name, supported generation methods and token limits

tools.name: generate_content
tools.description: Generate content from a Gemini model. This spends the account's token usage, so it is HITL-gated and never fired by the shape-proof harness (write:true means blind proof always SKIPs it; a real credential would also need --include-writes)

model.description: Gemini model id to route to (e.g. gemini-1.5-flash), from list_models

_scaffold.source: hand-authored 2026-09-16, frontier-LLM gap fill batch B (project_ai_tools_coverage_gaps_2026_09_16)
needs_review: NO LIVE CREDENTIAL AT AUTHORING TIME: this spec is shape-proved blind only. LIVE_PROVEN needs one real AIza... key against /v1beta/models, a zero-spend authed read per the coverage-gap plan.

generate_content is the only write:true tool: it is modelled for completeness but deliberately carries no _probe and is skipped by the shape-proof harness by default (writes_not_included), and even with --include-writes it only fires if the test call already proved an auth gate.

credentialType 'gemini' reuses the PRE-EXISTING vault type in integrationTypeRegistry.js (api_key field), whose own testEndpoint targets v1/models; this connector spec deliberately targets v1beta/models instead, per the coverage-gap plan's frontier-trio scope. No vault change needed for this connector.

SHAPE-PROOF FINDING (2026-09-16 run, real network, dummy key): GET /v1beta/models is AUTH-GATED, not keyless. It answers a dummy key with a structured 400 {"error":{"code":400,"status":"INVALID_ARGUMENT","message":"API key not valid. Please pass a valid API key."}}, which differs from the control probe's 404 (differential_path_proof), proving both the route and the auth gate. A real key would flip this to 2xx.
